purpose: End-to-end pi-level verification of the alza MCP server after the 2026-09-13 best-practices cycle: pi startup → MCP config load → alza connect → tool discovery → tools/call → live Alza data → final answer. Complements the in-memory eval harness (eval-2026-09-13.json) with pi's real MCP gateway (protocolVersion 2025-06-18 path, stdio transport).

runs.task_prompt: Use the alza MCP server: search Alza for "kabel hdmi", sorted by price ascending, only in-stock items, max price 300 CZK, limit 5. Report the cheapest product's name, price, product code, and Alza URL. Answer as a short 5-line list.
runs.tool_discovery: pi meta-tool mcp({search:"search",server:"alza"}) → alza_search_products ranked #1 with full description surfaced (including the client-side sort note from the 2026-09-12 fix).
runs.result_excerpt: Found 5 results for "kabel hdmi" (showing 5): Vention HDMI 2.0 High Quality Cable 1m Black · VENTc12 · 99 CZK · in stock · ★ 4.8; Vention HDMI 2.0 1.5m Black · VENTc13 · 109 CZK; …
runs.sort_verified: Results came back ascending by price (99, 109, …) — the client-side compareForSort fix from commit 5ec2527 is observable at the pi level (the 2026-09-12 run had observed unsorted upstream order).
runs.final_answer:
- Name: Vention HDMI 2.0 High Quality Cable 1m Black
- Price: 99 CZK (in stock)
- Product code: VENTc12
- Alza URL: https://www.alza.cz/vention-hdmi-2-0-high-quality-cable-1m-black-d5827419.htm
- Rating: ★ 4.8 — cheapest of 5 in-stock results under 300 CZK

runs.task_prompt: Use the alza MCP server: first confirm my Alza account is authenticated (account_status), then report my current cart state: how many items, the running total, and the currency. Do not add or remove anything. Answer as a short 3-line list, at most 30 words total.

tool_chain.result: alza_account_status surfaced (Read-only account/identity state: authenticated flag, visitorId, apiBaseUrl…)

tool_chain.result_excerpt: # Alza cart (user -1) 0 item line(s) items: Jsem tak prázdný... vouchers: 0 — full envelope in structuredContent

tool_chain.result: model explored the adapter envelope via mcpScript (2 script_error retries, then ok:true) — adapter-level batch path also reaches the server

runs.finding: Cart is empty (server msg "Jsem tak prázdný..."), so the running total is 0 CZK; the model reported this honestly instead of inventing items. account_status authenticated=true confirms the loaded token (err-0 path) works through pi.

runs.task_prompt: Use the alza MCP server: call prepare_mutation with action address_delete to mint a confirmation token. Report whether a confirmation token was returned and which action it is bound to. Do NOT call the actual address_delete mutation. Answer in at most 30 words.

tool_chain.result: full description surfaced: 'Start a two-step mutation by returning a one-time confirmation token bound to exactly one action. This call itself sends nothing to Alza…'

runs.final_answer: Yes — a one-time confirmation token was returned: ee14a0fb…, bound to the address_delete action. No address_delete mutation was executed.
runs.finding: The two-step mutation design is observable end-to-end through pi: the token minting is server-side (stateful), the description correctly told the model that 'this call sends nothing to Alza', and the model reported the action binding without executing the delete.

environment_notes: Model generation on the local proxy is slow at times (~2.6 s/token during one probe); two earlier attempts of run-2 timed out (420 s, then 720 s) while the two MCP tool calls had ALREADY completed successfully (isError false) — only the final answer generation was cut. The 1800 s rerun settled in 41 s; tool-call evidence from the timed-out attempts is consistent with the recorded one.
pi's adapter exposes MCP servers through meta-tools (mcp search/describe/call) plus mcpScript batch scripting; all 41 alza tools were discoverable and callable in both paths.
All three runs used the stdio transport via ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json; the in-memory harness evidence (eval-2026-09-13.json) remains the SDK-validated complement.
